decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to establish an aggressive board presence early in the game using efficient creatures such as Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear. This is supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear the way and finish off opponents. The deck also includes card draw and filtering options like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to maintain momentum. Overall, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and close out games quickly through a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells while assembling the powerful UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) to quickly ramp into colorless threats like Emrakul and Ugin. Dress Down and Stock Up provide card advantage and utility, while Giant's Boulder and Portent of Calamity help stall opponents. The goal is to eventually overwhelm the opponent with massive threats and powerful spells, all while maintaining control of the game through counter spells and disruptive effects like Ugin's Labyrinth.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies while utilizing blink effects to maximize value from entering the battlefield triggers. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, it can repeatedly flicker powerful creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk to create a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Thoughtseize provide additional disruption and control elements to ensure the deck can maintain pressure and control the pace of the game.

This Aggro-Hollow One deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard and bringing out powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One. Utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to dump cards into the graveyard, while Lightning Bolt provides removal and extra damage. Marauding Mako and Detective's Phoenix add additional threats to the board, creating a fast and powerful deck that aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and value from the graveyard.

This deck aims to win by casting Allosaurus Rider for free using Neoform or Eldritch Evolution, and then searching for and casting Griselbrand or Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant to deal a massive amount of damage to your opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Summoner's Pact and Pact of Negation to tutor for combo pieces and protect your board state. This combo-centric strategy requires careful timing and resource management to pull off consistently and efficiently.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to quickly play powerful threats such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. It also includes removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to control the board. Additionally, it has access to disruptive Eldrazi creatures like Sire of Seven Deaths and Devourer of Destiny to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the game with a mix of ramp, removal, and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that have blink abilities to repeatedly generate value by blinking powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan through discard spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while also controlling the board with removal spells. By constantly blinking creatures like Flickerwisp and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can maintain a strong board presence and out-value the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ephemerate and Solitude further enhances the deck's ability to control the game and maintain tempo.

The deck revolves around quickly getting cards into the graveyard to reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Quantum Riddler and Goryo's Vengeance. Utilizing instant speed interaction like Ephemerate and Force of Negation to protect the combo, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending. Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional value and a backup win condition. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with efficient creatures and utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Goblin Bombardment to maintain pressure and control the board. It also includes cards like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm for removal and disruption. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and spells, while also having some versatility and resilience with cards like Solitude and Voice of Victory. By combining aggressive tactics with card advantage and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to maintain momentum and find key cards. With a low mana curve and efficient removal options, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and win the game before the opponent can establish a strong board presence.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, and graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. The deck also includes creatures like Quantum Riddler, Psychic Frog, and Ketramose, the New Dawn to control the board and provide additional card advantage. The deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent while maintaining card advantage and board presence to ultimately secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play low-cost spells and creatures to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration for card advantage, as well as efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear serve as strong win conditions, with the ability to pump up their power and toughness with the spells being played. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient spellcasting.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played efficiently using cards like Green Sun's Zenith. By utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies, the deck aims to generate infinite mana to cast powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth for a game-winning attack. The inclusion of creatures like Shang-Chi and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional utility and value to the deck, while Leyline of Abundance helps ramp up mana production. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful combination of creatures and combo potential.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and aggressively attacking the opponent. The deck includes cards that can deal direct damage to the opponent such as Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge, as well as creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls that can quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory to provide additional support and finishers. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's resources and board state while maintaining a strong presence with a Boros color identity. This is achieved through a combination of land destruction with cards like Field of Ruin and Cleansing Wildfire, removal spells like Path to Exile and Galvanic Discharge, and powerful threats like Solitude and Wrath of the Skies. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional synergy and support for the control strategy. Overall, the goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands - Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower - to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Emrakul, the Promised End, as well as control spells like Ugin, the Eye of the Storms and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to slow down opponents, while also utilizing artifacts like Expedition Map and Mind Stone for card advantage and mana ramping.
